task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, attempt to move north. Then, take a trip east. Then, move north. With that over with, go to the north. Then, take a trip north. With that over with, attempt to venture west. Then, make an attempt to venture west. With that done, go to the west. After that, travel north. Following that, try to venture north. Following that, attempt to go north. And then, go to the east. That done, take a trip east. After that, make an attempt to venture east. Then, go to the east. After that, go north. Once you get around to doing that, attempt to take a trip north. If you can get around to doing that, head west. Then, take a trip north. And then, make an effort to move west. And then, make an effort to venture west. Next, take a trip west. Next, go to the south. If you can finish that, attempt to venture west. Then, head west. Then, travel south. If you can get through with that, try to move east. Then, attempt to venture north. And then, go to the west. Then, travel west. That done, make an attempt to venture north. Okay, and then, travel west. Then, go south. Then, take a trip west. That done, move north. Then, make an attempt to venture east. If you can succeed at that, go to the south. And then, try to head west. Then, venture north. Then, try to travel east. Next, move north. Then, travel east. Once you finish that, make an effort to travel east. With that done, make an attempt to move east. Then, travel east. And then, go to the north. Then, take a trip north. After that, recover the coin from the floor of the office. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
